claim: In mobile additive manufacturing, performing intermittent operations (e.g., feedstock preparation) during the travel time of the robotic platform increases overall system throughput.
falsifier: Implement a mobile AM system that performs feedstock preparation during travel and measure throughput compared to a system that does not utilize travel time.

conditions: the system is capable of performing intermittent operations (e.g., preparing feedstock) while the platform is moving
exclusions: limited to the simulated scenario and the specific proposed system; transfer to other types of operations or real-world constraints is unestablished

title: Performing intermittent operations during for system throughput
